data.exact_reserve_text: In 2019, there has been an overall deterioration of GBP 36.3m (2018: improvement of GBP 11.1m).

prior_year_events.impact_description: 2017 was impacted by the worst year for catastrophes in the United States for over a decade; contributed to adverse development on 2017 and prior years
Significant wildfire events in California contributed to 2017 catastrophes and adverse reserve development
Earthquakes in Mexico were part of the 2017 catastrophe activity affecting reserves
2018 was impacted by Hurricanes Florence & Michael and wildfire events; these were smaller than 2017 but were net retained and contributed to adverse development on open years

named_events.loss_description: Impacted 2017 making it the costliest year on record for natural catastrophes; contributed to loss on 2017 year of account
Significant wildfires contributed to 2017 catastrophe activity
Earthquakes in Mexico were part of the 2017 catastrophe profile
2018 was impacted by Hurricanes Florence & Michael and wildfire events which were smaller than 2017 and were net retained by the syndicate

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded an overall adverse development on reserves in 2019 amounting to a deterioration of GBP 36.3m (approximately 4.7% of opening gross claims outstanding). This strengthening of reserves was driven by a series of large catastrophe and loss developments predominantly relating to the 2017 and prior underwriting years (notably Hurricanes Harvey, Irma and Maria, California wildfires and Mexico earthquakes), together with attritional deterioration and weaker-than-expected short-tail loss ratios in classes such as US Direct & Facultative, Cargo, Yachts & Hull, UK SME and Onshore energy. The impact was felt across Property, Casualty, Marine and Energy portfolios and has resulted in management taking remediation and portfolio actions.
raw_causal_phrases: series of large losses on 2017 and prior underwriting years
increased attritional losses on those same years
deterioration from expected loss ratios from short tail lines of business
large loss notifications late in the year on our long tail lines of business for years 2017 and prior

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development amount taken from explicit narrative sentence 'overall deterioration of GBP 36.3m'. The report contains a gross claims development triangle but the printed table includes an aggregated '2012 and prior' column and ragged rows; a full cell-by-cell extraction of the triangle was not reliably parsed here, so the triangle was not used to independently compute PYD. If a strict triangle-derived prior-year movement is required, a manual review of the printed triangle table is recommended. Where LOB-specific reserve movements are not quantified in the report, amounts are left null.

_claims_triangle.notes: A gross claims development table is present in the report (contains an aggregate '2012 and prior' column and ragged rows). The cell-level triangle was not fully parsed here; therefore development rows are omitted from this extract. The report does state an overall deterioration of GBP 36.3m which has been used as the prior-year movement figure.
